kashika: द्वन्द्वे च समासे सर्वादीनि सर्वनामसंज्ञानि न भवन्ति। पूर्वापराणाम्। कतरकतमानाम्॥
kashikaEnglish: In dvandva compounds, sarvādi words are not pronouns.
englishShort: The words formed by the द्वन्द्व समास of the words of सर्वादिगण are not called सर्वनाम.
englishFull:
In द्वन्द्व (collective) compounds, सर्व-words are not सर्वनाम.

**Example:** वर्णाश्रमेतर "castes, orders, and others":
- Genitive plural: वर्णाश्रमेतराणाम् (regular)
- Not: वर्णाश्रमेतरेषाम् (pronominal)

The word च "and" signals the end of this exception series that began at @ref[1.1.29].
